verifyDefaults.$comment: Genericized lint + test + coverage chain for a Python service with a .venv at the repo root. Swap flake8/mypy/pytest for ruff/etc. to match your project. These are copied into skills-config.json verify.defaults.python on activation (only stages the user hasn't set).

hooks.summary: Enforce the project venv rule: a single .venv at the repo root, and EVERY Python command (pip/python/pytest/mypy/…) must run inside it — bare system-interpreter commands are blocked. Allows activation, explicit .venv/bin paths, and venv-aware runners (uv run/poetry run/tox). verify_venv* throwaways exempt.

Enforce the project venv STRUCTURE rule: virtualenv-creation commands (python -m venv, virtualenv, uv venv) must target the canonical .venv at the repo root only. Allows CI throwaway patterns (verify_venv*). Lighter-weight than enforce-venv.sh; does not check activation or bare Python commands.

Block irreversible alembic migrations (alembic downgrade base / relative rollback). Python-stack-specific, so pack-scoped rather than in the core git guard. Targeted downgrades to a specific revision are allowed.
